readback.name: Poincare.GlobalParametrixAssembly.ambient_mem_and_chart_value
readback.mathematical_statement: Let E3 be EuclideanSpace R (Fin 3), the real three-dimensional Euclidean vector space. For every universe u, let M : Type u have a topology, an E3 charted-space structure, and the C-infinity IsManifold structure for the boundaryless closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3, at the ENat top injected into WithTop ENat. Let A : AtlasData M, with finite extended charts C_j, open subordinate covering regions whose closures lie in their chart sources and have compact coordinate images, and a smooth partition of unity p_j. No Hausdorff, CompactSpace, connectedness, metric, or flow hypothesis is explicitly assumed. Let alpha and T be arbitrary real parameters. Scalar alpha T is the original scalar-valued Y space, and Jet alpha T is the original Graph space over E3. Y fields are zero off the cylinder Icc 0 T times all of E3 and their norm is the sum of the value supremum and the alpha-Hoelder seminorm measured within that cylinder, with parabolic distance norm(x-y) + sqrt(abs(t-s)). Graph contains u,ut,du,ddu Y fields, zero initial u trace, genuine ordinary spatial derivative certificates u -> du -> ddu for times in Icc 0 T, and a within-Icc 0 T time derivative certificate u -> ut. Its norm is the sum of the four Y norms. Y_M A alpha T is the canonical submodule subtype of chart/component-indexed Scalar entries satisfying pointwise spatial support in coordSupport A j, symmetry in the two component indices, and the original partition-weighted overlap equation on genuine chart overlaps. Its norm is inherited from the existing finite Pi norm on those Scalar entries. SourceGraphs alpha T is the nine-component function space (Fin 3 times Fin 3) -> Jet alpha T with its existing finite Pi norm. Let S_j be any family of continuous real-linear maps Scalar alpha T -> Jet alpha T. Let B be any Transports A alpha T family, with B_ijcd : SourceGraphs alpha T ->L[R] Jet alpha T. The pinned localGraphs_j map sends f in Y_M to the family (a,b) |-> S_j(f.val(j,a,b)), using the same S_j on every source component. The actual pinned ambient continuous real-linear map has component ambient(f)_(i,c,d) = the finite sum over every source chart j of B_ijcd(localGraphs_j(f)). Its codomain is the original LocalProduct A (Jet alpha T), the finite Pi space of chart/component-indexed Graphs, before any codomain restriction. For every arbitrary scalar buffer family xi_j : E3 -> R, assume two concrete conditions on B. First, for every i,j,c,d, every arbitrary source Graph family w, every real t, and every z outside coordSupport A i, (B_ijcd w).u(t,z) = 0. Second, for every such i,j,c,d,w,t and every x in source(C_i), (B_ijcd w).u(t,C_i(x)) equals p_i(x) times a real-valued piecewise expression: if x is in source(C_j), the expression is the double sum over a,b : Fin 3 of xi_j(C_j(x)) * J_ij(x)_(a,c) * J_ij(x)_(b,d) * (w(a,b)).u(t,C_j(x)); otherwise it is zero. Here J_ij(x)_(a,c) = jac A i j x a c is the a-th component of the derivative of the i-to-j coordinate transition C_j composed with C_i.symm, at C_i(x), applied to basis vector e_c. The output/source-field index is a and the input/destination-field index is c. The source indicator is explicitly @ite R with Classical.propDecidable, and only destination partition p_i is inserted. Then for every already compatible forcing f in Y_M, ambient(f) belongs to tensorSubmodule A (evalX alpha T). Since evalX evaluates the u field of a Graph, this membership asserts the original u-value support, component symmetry, and partition-weighted overlap equations; it does not separately state derivative-component overlap formulas. Every ambient entry is still a genuine Graph with all its existing derivative certificates. The theorem also asserts the exact chart-value identity for every f,i,c,d, every real t, and every x in source(C_i): ambient(f)_(i,c,d).u(t,C_i(x)) = value A xi W i c d x, where for the fixed t the source scalar array is W_jab(z) = (S_j(f.val(j,a,b))).u(t,z). The pinned value is p_i(x) times the finite source-chart sum with each genuine source-chart membership indicator, source buffer xi_j, two actual Jacobian factors, and source value W_jab(C_j(x)). Both the B premises and the chart conclusion cover all real evaluation times, including the zero-extended off-cylinder region. No regularity, compact support, or range assumption on xi is present. S_j is not assumed to send the forcing to spatially supported or already compatible source tensors; there is no extra compatibility package premise. The existing compatibility of f in Y_M and the use of the same S_j on symmetric source slots are retained. Alpha and T have no sign or interval restrictions, and this statement makes no T-uniform choice of data. It establishes the range and exact values of this defined ambient map under its explicit B support/value premises. It does not itself construct A,S,B from a metric, define the codomain-restricted global P, give a norm bound, assert a PDE residual identity or contraction, or produce physical Ricci flow or Hamilton convergence. Within-time Graph certificates do not assert ordinary joint C3 regularity at zero.
